pillars.heading: A softer, smarter path to sustainable wellness.

items.title: MINDSET
items.text: Break the all-or-nothing cycle. Build a relationship with food and your body that doesn't require perfection to work.

items.title: NUTRITION
items.text: No calorie counting. No restriction. Real food strategies that fit your real life and include dessert.

items.title: MOVEMENT
items.text: Find movement you actually enjoy. Yoga, strength, cardio. Whatever keeps you showing up consistently, for life.

items.title: ACCOUNTABILITY
items.text: Weekly calls, daily app access, and a coach who genuinely celebrates every win, big and small, with you

cta.heading: Begin your next chapter feeling nourished, strong, and supported.

testimonials.heading: Real women. Real lives. Real results.

items.title: I lost 80 pounds, 20 pounds more than my goal weight!
items.text: I lost 80 pounds over COVID with Bri’s coaching. She is compassionate but also keeps you accountable. I wouldn’t have been able to achieve this goal for myself without her guidance. I’m so grateful for her help.
items.name: Jessica, Client

items.title: So much clarity!
items.text: Bri and I went on a grocery shopping tour. It gave me so much clarity and confidence to go shopping on my own.
items.name: Leslie, Client

items.title: I can bake and not binge!
items.text: I love baking. Working with Bri has taught me that I can love baking and not overindulge on my own creations. I now give them away to friends and they love my baking too!
items.name: Tamara, Client

items.title: Now I have a better relationship with food!
items.text: I’ve always had a horrible relationship with food and my body. Bri has taught me to see food as fuel and how to add movement into my daily routine. I love the replays when I can’t make live classes.
items.name: Audrey, Client and Reset Studio Member

items.title: No more leg pain!
items.text: Before working with Brianna I was dealing with constant pain. Brianna makes our classes just what I need to manage my chronic pain. I can also feel circulation in my legs again!
items.name: Riviera, Yoga Student

items.title: We feel like we did when we got married!
items.text: My wife and I ate healthy in our youth and then when we had kids we kind of fell off. When we worked with Bri, I lost over 25 pounds and my wife hit her goal. We gained time back with each other by making workouts a family activity.
items.name: Ty, Client

items.title: She’s so motivational and fun!
items.text: I took the 6 week challenge with Bri. I loved the daily accountability texts. She’s so motivational and I was really inspired to finish the challenge strong.
items.name: Deanna, Client

items.title: Now I actually exercise!
items.text: Working with Bri helped me to include exercise into my day and I now think differently about the foods I eat.
items.name: Whitney, Client

items.title: I hit my goal and maintained!
items.text: Bri helped me hit my goal and I stayed on with her for maintenance coaching to help in that first year after the weight loss. My daughter got married within that time and Bri helped me stay on track so I looked and felt fabulous in my MOB dress. She is amazing and super encouraging.
items.name: Michelle, Client

aboutPreview.heading: Helping women reconnect with themselves.
aboutPreview.description: After years of helping women transform their health, Brianna learned that sustainable wellness isn't created through perfection. It's created through compassion, movement, nutrition, and mindset.

quote.text: True wellness isn't about becoming someone else. It's remembering who you've always been.
quote.author: Brianna Wohner
